facts.text: Sunnyside Gardens features twelve named courts, most of which are named after American presidents and other historical figures.
Actress Judy Holliday grew up in Sunnyside Gardens, living in one of the neighborhood's original homes.
Social critic Lewis Mumford lived in Sunnyside Gardens from 1925 to 1936 and called the development a model housing estate.
The Pat's for All parade, an LGBT-inclusive alternative to the Manhattan Saint Patrick's Day Parade, runs along the southern edge of the district.
Sunnyside Gardens was nominated for listing on the National Register of Historic Places and approved by the National Park Service in 1984.
